# Long skill files cost more tokens than they save

## What happened

The trace review of 2 November looked at 12 agent runs. The three skills whose `SKILL.md` ran over 300 lines cost
about 9,400 input tokens in every session that loaded them. In each run the agent used one section of the skill;
the worked examples and reference tables were never read. Moving the examples of one skill into a separate file
cut its share to 2,100 tokens with no change in the run's outcome.

## What to do next time

Keep a skill's `SKILL.md` under 150 lines. Put worked examples and reference tables in files beside it that the
skill names, so a session reads them only when it needs them.
